sumstats_files.description: Input GWAS summary statistics files (either one genome sumstats file or per-chromosome sumstats files per trait/study).

ref_snp_list.description: Reference SNP list (HM3) for munging and sumstats.

sumstats_columns.description: Per-file column-name mapping used for preprocessing.

sample_prevs.description: Sample prevalences per trait for LDSC.

population_prevs.description: Population prevalences per trait for LDSC.

estimation_method.description: Estimation method for common-factor GWAS (for example, DWLS).

se_logit.description: Per-trait indicator that SE is on the logistic scale.

ols.description: Optional per-trait OLS indicator for sumstats().

linprob.description: Optional per-trait linear probability indicator for sumstats().

betas.description: Optional per-trait beta column names for sumstats().

info_filter.description: INFO/R2 threshold used by gsem_munge and gsem_sumstats.

maf_filter.description: MAF threshold used by gsem_munge and gsem_sumstats.

cores.description: Number of cores when parallel processing is enabled.

no_overwrite.description: If true, do not overwrite existing munged outputs.

keep_indel.description: If true, keep indels in gsem_sumstats processing.

toler.description: Optional matrix inversion tolerance for commonfactorgwas.

snpse.description: Optional SNP standard error override for commonfactorgwas.

gc.description: Genomic control mode: standard, conserv, or none.

munge_out_dir.description: Output directory for munged summary statistics.

preprocessing_out_dir.description: Output directory for preprocessed summary statistics.

commonfactorgwas_output_prefix.description: Output prefix for common-factor GWAS output.

ecr_repo.description: Optional ECR repository URI prefix used with the task ecr image name.

image_source.description: Container source selector: docker or ecr.

tsv_append_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for tsv_append task runtime.

tsv_append_mem_gb.description: Requested memory for tsv_append task runtime in GB.

preprocessing_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for preprocessing task runtime.

preprocessing_mem_gb.description: Requested memory for preprocessing task runtime in GB.

munge_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for munge task runtime.

munge_mem_gb.description: Optional override for munge task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed as 1.5x(sumstats file size + ref_snp_list size), rounded to (2^n - 1) GB.

ldsc_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for ldsc task runtime.

ldsc_mem_gb.description: Optional override for ldsc task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed as 1.5x(munged sumstats + ld_dir + wld_dir sizes), rounded to (2^n - 1) GB.

sumstats_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for sumstats task runtime.

sumstats_mem_gb.description: Optional override for sumstats task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed as 1.5x(sumstats file size + ref_snp_list size), rounded to (2^n - 1) GB.

commonfactorgwas_cpu.description: Requested CPU cores for commonfactorgwas task runtime.

commonfactorgwas_mem_gb.description: Optional override for commonfactorgwas task runtime memory; if unset, memory is computed as 1.5x(ldsc_rds + sumstats_rds sizes), rounded to (2^n - 1) GB.
